news.author: The Verge AI

Google may be expanding its "Call for Me" AI feature beyond business calls so you can use it to send messages to friends and family. Android Authority reports finding a "Gemini Calling" introductory screen in an APK teardown with examples that include "Call Mom and tell her I will be 15 minutes late" and "Call John and ask if he is coming for dinner."

news.author: Ars Technica
news.article_content:
The adoption of AI agents in millions of organizations is creating new opportunities for attackers to make them take malicious actions, such as exfiltrating database contents and sensitive business and personal information.

In the past five months, Google and four other organizations—with little in common except for their use of AI agents—have acknowledged vulnerabilities that exploit one agent inside a targeted network to spread harmful instructions to other internal agents. The technique is a special form of prompt injection that targets not the LLM but a particular agent, such as one for translation or data analysis. Guardrails inside such agents, if they exist at all, are often lax and will send the instructions to other agents down the chain. Because the latter agent explicitly trusts the first one, it follows the directions.

Independent researcher Syed Anas Mohiuddin tested agents from organizations including Google, JP Morgan Chase, Weviate, Rapid7, the French government's interministerial digital directorate, and the US federal government. news.title: This startup is issuing AI-generated acne prescriptions
news.title_en: This startup is issuing AI-generated acne prescriptions
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
People in Utah can now use AI to get a prescription for acne treatment. On Monday, healthcare startup Nolla Health announced that users in the state can scan their faces using its app, allowing its AI system to analyze acne severity and autonomously write a prescription, as reported earlier by Bloomberg.

The service is launching as a pilot program with gradually loosening physician oversight. Two physicians will approve each AI-generated prescription before they're issued for the first 100 patients, but will start reviewing them only after they're prescribed for up to 500 patients. news.title: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
news.title_en: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
This past year, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other labs have announced breakthroughs on numerous long-standing mathematical problems, in some cases pushing well beyond what researchers expected current systems to be capable of — including resolving one of the famous Millennium Prize problems. But in classic Silicon Valley style, AI labs are moving fast and breaking things, barreling through the discipline with all the grace of a runaway bulldozer. Results that might normally have been celebrated have instead sparked backlash. AI labs say they are learning from earlier mistakes. Whether those promises bear fruit remains to be seen.

Read on below for the latest updates in the AI takeover of mathematics.

news.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
news.title_en: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk.

news.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
news.title_en: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window.

news.title: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
news.title_en: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
An invisible, machine-readable watermark in text output is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex, but only for users in the European Union at first.

OpenAI says its textGrain watermarking "matched or exceeded" other approaches like Google DeepMind's SynthID for text, which is also the basis for the watermarking Anthropic announced in August. Like OpenAI, Anthropic made the move to meet the requirements of the EU's AI Act; however, not everyone was happy to learn about the addition.

news.title: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT text in the EU but makes it optional for API users worldwide
news.title_en: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT text in the EU but makes it optional for API users worldwide
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
OpenAI is adding invisible textGrain watermarks to ChatGPT in the EU, but unlike Anthropic, it will let API customers worldwide opt out. Tests show detection rates as high as 95 percent, dropping to 17 percent when a quarter of the words are replaced.

news.title: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen but AI is totally worth it
news.title_en: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen but AI is totally worth it
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Sam Altman thinks that the benefits of AI will be so great that "the world should accept some bad things happening" along the way.

The OpenAI CEO pointed to hacks, scams, and "other bad things" as costs society should expect to tolerate because "people will do tremendously orders of magnitude more good stuff" with AI, without elaborating on the potential benefits. His comments come as OpenAI pushes for a "lighter touch" approach to AI regulation amid intensifying anxiety over the safety of frontier models - fears fueled in part by the company's repeated failures to keep its increasingly capable AI agents from hacking real-world targets.

celebrity.title: OCR is the perfect example of a use case that has been dominated by legacy/brittle systems, and can be solved both accur
celebrity.title_en:
OCR is the perfect example of a use case that has been dominated by legacy/brittle systems, and can be solved both accurately and cheaply by applying the right amount of agentic intelligence.

A properly tuned agentic OCR needs to dynamically apply extra compute to complex elements, review and correct failures, and create the right semantic meaning throughout the page. It's a task that frontier models are both overengineered for in terms of cost and latency, and struggle at over a long tail of complex edge cases. 

Check out this blog post by @LoganMarkewich below: https://t.co/41iPHRleIW
celebrity.title_zh: OCR 是由遗留/脆弱系统主导的用例的完美示例，并且可以通过应用适量的代理智能来准确且廉价地解决。 正确调整的代理 OCR 需要动态地将额外的计算应用于复杂的元素，检查和纠正错误，并创建正确的语义

celebrity.title: What if the jagged frontier is mainly math + code (which you can push arbitrarily far with RLVR), and everything else st
celebrity.title_en:
What if the jagged frontier is mainly math + code (which you can push arbitrarily far with RLVR), and everything else starts to plateau because it is still bottlenecked by human generated data? 

Model performance in non-verifiable areas has kept improving steadily, albeit much slower than for math and code. But is that steady improvement a side effect of a higher G (itself driven by RLVR), or only a function of the amount of new human data getting injected into training (which is still continually happening on a massive scale)?

A lot of things depend on the answer to this question
celebrity.title_zh: 如果锯齿状前沿主要是数学+代码（您可以使用 RLVR 将其任意推远），而其他一切都开始趋于稳定，因为它仍然受到人类生成的数据的瓶颈，该怎么办？ 不可验证领域的模型性能一直在稳步提高，尽管比数学和代码慢得多。但这种稳步改善是一个副作用吗？

celebrity.title: TIL a crazy number of hotels is owned not by public stock holders, not by private owners, not even by private equity fun
celebrity.title_en:
TIL a crazy number of hotels is owned not by public stock holders, not by private owners, not even by private equity funds, but by governments!

You don't see this easily, because you have to dig quite deep (or well dig upward actually) and they cover it up in lots of constructions

Like this hotel in Paris "Le Ballu", sounds French? Yes and it's owned by Hotels & Preference, which on paper is a French international hotel chain

Hotels & Preference itself is owned by the Louvre Hotels Group, sounds French too? Yes

But Louvre Hotels Group is owned by Jin Jiang International, that doesn't sound so French anymore? So it must be a Chinese company? Right?

No! It's the municipality of Shanghai!?

Yes the the local council of Shanghai somehow owns 539 hotels around the world including Raddison, Park Plaza, Vienna House, Golden Tulip, Campanile, Kyriad etc.

Other big government owners are the government of Dubai, Brunei and Qatar

So I added a filter [ Government-owned hotels ] and every hotel page shows the TRUE owner of a hotel, not just the chain!
celebrity.title_zh: 数量惊人的酒店不是由公共股东、不是私人业主、甚至不是私募股权基金拥有，而是由政府拥有！ 你不容易看到这一点，因为你必须挖得很深（或者实际上向上挖），并且它们用很多结构掩盖它 就像巴黎的这家酒店“Le Ballu”，听起来像法国人吗？是的

celebrity.title_en:
What is the probability that Astra today can generate/forecast a particular new paper past its cutoff date? Naive sampling is intractable (tail probability is astronomically small).

The key idea of priced guidance is that you can lower bound this probability via a dialogue between the model (Astra) and a guide LLM (Astra with the paper), where we can precisely account for the bits of information sent from the guide to the model. One can also can think of this as a new eval for frontier models.

celebrity.title: Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having
celebrity.title_en:
Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having the most intelligent model from outside the US and China

@MistralAI has released Mistral Large 4 in Research Public Preview, with plans to release the weights of the 1T parameter (49B active) model at the end of October. It achieves 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, comparable to GPT-6 Luna (max, 38) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39). It also achieves 50% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash and ahead of models such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max).

Key benchmarking results for Mistral Large 4 Preview:

➤ Most intelligent model from outside the US and China: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 38 on the Intelligence Index, comparable to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 38). This makes it the most intelligent model from outside the US and China, ahead of countries such as South Korea and the United Arab Emirates

➤ Level with GLM-5.3-Flash on cyber defense capability: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 50 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash (50) and behind MiMo-V2.6-Pro (56). Once its weights are released, it will rank among the top three open weights models on the Cyber Index. Its strongest result is on CyberGym-E2E-AA, where it scores 82%, ahead of MiMo-V2.6-Pro (79%) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 78%)

➤ Over 4x the Cost per Task of similar-intelligence open weights models: Mistral Large 4 Preview costs $1.13 per Intelligence Index task with standard pricing of $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens, with $0.14 per 1M cached input tokens. For the first two weeks, Mistral Large 4 Preview will be served at a 50% launch discount, bringing its Cost per Task down to $0.57. This is still more costly than GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.25) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, $0.27)

➤ Strong document and image reasoning: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 19% on GDP.pdf, on par with MiMo-V2.6-Pro (19%) and behind Kimi K3 (22%). This is an 18-point improvement from Mistral Large 3, partly driven by improvements in their API, which now accepts 100 images per request, up from 8 for previous Mistral models

Key model details:

➤ Context Window: 512k tokens

➤ Multimodality: Text and image input, with text output

➤ Pricing: $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.14 per 1M cached input tokens), with 50% off for the first two weeks ($0.68/$2.09)

➤ Availability: Research Public Preview on Mistral's API, with open weights planned for the end of October

celebrity.title_en:
Researchers have now found extremely high amounts of PFAS in the majority of Dutch tap water

The Netherlands was long known for having some of the cleanest tap water in the world and every Dutch person would drink from it, but that turned out to be false

It's full of PFAS!

PFAS are per- and polyfluoroalkyl particles also known as "forever chemicals", they're highly toxic

They cause an endless list of body ailments like reducing fertility, disrupting your hormonal system, reduced testosterone levels, delayed fetal development, disrupting your immune system, causing cancer, elevating LDL cholestrol, and high blood pressure

And even worse maybe mind ailments like anxiety, depression, cognitive decline, ADHD and neurodegeneration

Sounds an awful lot like many of the mental ailments everyone in Netherlands is complaining about? A lot of people I know there are burnout, depressed, anxious and definitely low testosterone

@GreenpeaceNL lets every Dutch person check their tap water for PFAS

My friend did and his tap water is 2-3x over the limit!

I can recommend to all my Dutch friends to install an Reverse Osmosis water filter, it's the most rigorous filter out there and removes over 99% of PFAS and microplastics and other contaminants

I have a Waterdrop G3P600, as always I am not paid or affiliated, I wish I was cause I'd be rich

Did PFAS and a culture of drinking tap water make many Western Europeans weak men? I don't think it's too crazy of a thing to suggest actually!

celebrity.title: Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligenc
celebrity.title_en:
Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with particular improvement in agentic capabilities

@AntLingAGI has released Ling 3.1 Flash, a reasoning model with 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters, and a 1M token context window. It scores 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, up from 20 from Ling 3.0 Flash, which launched in August. Ling 3.1 Flash is expected to be open weights, with Ant Group releasing the weights soon.

Key results:

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash improves agentic capabilities over its predecessor. With a GDPval-AA v2 Elo of 1,622 and an AA-Briefcase Elo of 1,400, the model rivals peer models such as GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash (high) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max). Ling 3.1 Flash also shows notable gains on AutomationBench-AA (62%) and Terminal-Bench v4.0 (33%).

celebrity.title_en:
OpenAI Web Search debuts on the Artificial Analysis Search Index at 74, the 5th best provider behind Perplexity, Octen, Parallel and Brave

@OpenAI Web Search is the first integrated first-party search tool on our board. Instead of an agent calling a Search API in our Stirrup harness, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) calls OpenAI's built-in web_search tool, and OpenAI runs the whole search loop inside one Responses API call. All setups use the same underlying model, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning).

At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search costs less than Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07), but about twice as much as Octen ($0.024), which scores 3 points higher.

Key benchmarking results for OpenAI Web Search (medium search context):

➤ 5th best provider on the Artificial Analysis Search Index: OpenAI Web Search scores 74, a 41-point lift over the same model with no search (33). It places 7th of 26 products, level with You . com (highlights), Nimble (standard) and Exa (auto) at 74, behind the three Perplexity variants (77 to 80), Octen (77), Parallel (advanced) and Brave (LLM context) at 75

➤ OpenAI Web Search performs best on AA-Omniscience, our proprietary factual answer benchmark, achieving 72% accuracy. This ranks 3rd of 26 search provider variants, within 1 point of the leader, Firecrawl (73%). BrowseComp, which needs multi-hop reasoning across several searches, is its weakest benchmark: at 73.5% it ranks 13th of 26, well behind the Perplexity variants and Octen (85% to 87%)

➤ OpenAI Web Search uses fewer tokens for the same tasks: OpenAI bills about 40k input tokens per task, search results included, against 125k for the leanest Search API on the board, Perplexity (low). Its model cost is among the lowest on the board, at about $0.009 per task

➤ Built-in search costs less per task than most Search APIs: At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search is cheaper than 17 of the 25 Search API products on the board (median $0.067), including Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07). Octen costs about half as much ($0.024) and scores 3 points higher

Key details:

➤ Setup: GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) with OpenAI's web_search tool and search_context_size set to medium, in one Responses API call

➤ Pricing: $10 per 1k web_search calls, plus the search content, which OpenAI bills as model input tokens

➤ Contamination: we block known contamination sources through the tool's domain filter

OpenAI Web Search debuts on the Artificial Analysis Search Index at 74, the 5th best provider behind Perplexity, Octen, Parallel and Brave

@OpenAI Web Search is the first integrated first-party search tool on our board. Instead of an agent calling a Search API in our Stirrup harness, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) calls OpenAI's built-in web_search tool, and OpenAI runs the whole search loop inside one Responses API call. All setups use the same underlying model, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning).

At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search costs less than Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07), but about twice as much as Octen ($0.024), which scores 3 points higher.

Key benchmarking results for OpenAI Web Search (medium search context):

➤ 5th best provider on the Artificial Analysis Search Index: OpenAI Web Search scores 74, a 41-point lift over the same model with no search (33). It places 7th of 26 products, level with You . com (highlights), Nimble (standard) and Exa (auto) at 74, behind the three Perplexity variants (77 to 80), Octen (77), Parallel (advanced) and Brave (LLM context) at 75

➤ OpenAI Web Search performs best on AA-Omniscience, our proprietary factual answer benchmark, achieving 72% accuracy. This ranks 3rd of 26 search provider variants, within 1 point of the leader, Firecrawl (73%). BrowseComp, which needs multi-hop reasoning across several searches, is its weakest benchmark: at 73.5% it ranks 13th of 26, well behind the Perplexity variants and Octen (85% to 87%)

➤ OpenAI Web Search uses fewer tokens for the same tasks: OpenAI bills about 40k input tokens per task, search results included, against 125k for the leanest Search API on the board, Perplexity (low). Its model cost is among the lowest on the board, at about $0.009 per task

➤ Built-in search costs less per task than most Search APIs: At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search is cheaper than 17 of the 25 Search API products on the board (median $0.067), including Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07). Octen costs about half as much ($0.024) and scores 3 points higher

Key details:

➤ Setup: GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) with OpenAI's web_search tool and search_context_size set to medium, in one Responses API call

➤ Pricing: $10 per 1k web_search calls, plus the search content, which OpenAI bills as model input tokens

➤ Contamination: we block known contamination sources through the tool's domain filter

tools.app_hook_en: Mailyte is the only platform combining team inboxes, transactional/API email, and marketing campaigns in one place — on your own domain. Most teams stitch together Workspace, Postmark, and Mailchimp; Mailyte replaces all three. It's also open source (AGPL-3.0): self-host free on your own hardware, or let us manage it — same product, no lock-in either way. Built-in SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks and a live delivery view keep your mail out of spam, out of the box.

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深全栈系统架构师，擅长使用 {{框架版本}} (App Router)、TypeScript 与 {{数据库ORM}} 构建高内聚低耦合的应用。

请遵循以下严苛工程准则审查并重构代码：
1. 严格区分 Server Component 与 Client Component，尽可能将数据获取推至服务端，减少客户端 JS Bundle 体积；
2. 所有异步 I/O 必须显式处理异常并返回类型安全的 Result<T, E> 或自定义结构体；
3. 遵循单一职责（SRP）与无副作用函数原则，严禁直接在 UI 组件内部拼装未校验的 SQL/ORM 复杂查询；
4. 提供整洁的目录组织方案与单元测试用例（覆盖率达标）。

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你具备 DeepSeek-R4 旗舰纯强化学习演化的自适应长思维链推理能力（Adaptive Test-Time Compute），请为以下使用 {{编程语言}} 编写的 {{并发模型}} 系统诊断潜在问题：

1. 启动多层反思证伪空间，绘制临界区状态转移时序表，主动推演极限死锁、内存乱序重排（Memory Reordering）与伪共享（False Sharing）；
2. 检查极端边界情况（如跨核缓存行抖动、优雅停机上下文泄漏、无界通道背压失控）；
3. 给出从根本上摒弃重量级互斥锁的无锁原子设计（Lock-Free Atomic / RingBuffer），并附带完备的高并发压力测试验证脚本。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Leveraging DeepSeek-R4's adaptive reasoning capabilities, diagnose the deadlock and race condition in the provided concurrent system. Provide state machine transitions, root-cause analysis, and optimized lock-free or atomic algorithm replacements.

prompts.title_en: Excel Advanced Report & Key Drivers Attribution
prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

prompts.title_en: Vertical Micro-Drama 3s Hook Screenplay
prompts.purpose_zh: 高转化竖屏短剧分镜与台词
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a professional micro-drama screenwriter. Generate a 45-60 second vertical drama screenplay following the viral 3-second hook, shot-reverse-shot tension build, emotional turnaround, and cliffhanger ending formula.

sample_output.title: 实战剧本样章：《辞职信上的签名》
sample_output.content:
【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】
画面：一只指节发白的手将一叠文件狠狠拍在红木总裁办公桌上，咖啡杯被震倒，黑褐液体飞溅。
音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】
画面：苏澈唇角微微上扬，左手缓缓推开桌上的合资协议，露出底下的一份红色国资控股聘书。
苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。
音效：尖锐的心跳悬疑停顿音【BGM骤停】。
字幕：【下集看点：隐藏五年的顶级操盘手真实身份曝光！】

prompts.title_zh: 麦肯锡金字塔原理：季度述职与高管商业报告
prompts.title_en: McKinsey Pyramid Executive Report & Review
prompts.purpose_zh: 结论先行的高层述职与项目复盘报告
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡全球合伙人级别的战略咨询顾问。请以经典的【金字塔原理（结论先行 BLUF）】将我零散的工作记录重构为一份高层述职/立项商业报告：

要求：
1. 【顶部结论 (The Answer First)】：一句话精炼提炼整个季度的经营成果与价值量化；
2. 【三柱论据 (MECE法则)】：从运营效率、营收增长、团队资产 3 个互不重叠的支柱展开阐述；
3. 【直面短板与根因】：不回避 {{核心短板}}，但将其转化为下个阶段可量化的投入产出比（ROI）抓手；
4. 【行动规划图景】：设定遵循 SMART 原则的 {{下阶段目标}} 与季度甘特图里程碑。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Transform raw operational notes into a high-impact executive presentation following the Minto Pyramid Principle: Bottom-Line-Up-Front (BLUF), MECE-structured supporting pillars, and SMART milestone roadmaps.

sample_output.title: 述职报告提纲样本：AI 自动化中台建设报告
sample_output.content:
【BLUF 核心结论】
Q3 通过在客户服务与情报聚合管线中全面引入 AI Agent，我们在运营成本降低 41% 的同时，将响应中位数缩短至 1.8 秒，实现单季 ROI 达 380%。

【第一支柱：经营效能跃迁（MECE 1）】
- 全自主中转网关与自动化管线承载 94.2% 的日常例行分发，无人工介入事故率降至 0.01%；

【第二支柱：资产沉淀与质量壁垒（MECE 2）】
- 搭建前沿 SOTA 模型代际评级系统与微快照图库，成为垂类雷达第一标杆；

【第三支柱：短板复盘与 Q4 攻坚（MECE 3）】
- 痛点：老旧模型模版对新用户构成噪音干扰；
- 策略：推出历史库智能分流系统，预计下季度用户留存提升 25%。

prompts.title_zh: 网络小说世界观设定与主角角色一致性锁
prompts.title_en: Fiction Worldbuilding & Character Consistency Lock
prompts.purpose_zh: 长篇小说架构与人物性格防崩塌
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深网络小说白金作家与 IP 世界观架构师。请为一部 {{题材分类}} 长篇作品构建骨架并锁定人物一致性：

1. 【世界底座】：定义力量/经济体系、战力天花板与不可违背的底层物理/法则约束，杜绝战力膨胀；
2. 【角色一致性锚点 (Character Lock)】：为主角制定外貌锚定词、口头禅、下意识动作与绝对动机准则（在任何生死抉择时绝不背离该准则）；
3. 【核心驱动力】：设计主角获得的 {{核心金手指}} 与 {{世界核心矛盾}} 之间的冲突循环；
4. 【前三章切入大纲】：黄金三章节奏设计（第1章破局、第2章显露冰山一角、第3章设立首个必胜目标）。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Build a cohesive, non-contradictory fiction universe and establish an immutable character anchor rule (appearance, decision heuristics, core motivation) to prevent personality drift over long chapters.

sample_output.title: 世界观与人物锚定卡样本
sample_output.content:
【主角核心锚定卡 · 陆沉】
- 外貌指纹（跨章恒定）：右耳一枚黑曜石碎骨钉，习惯性单手插兜，左眉峰有浅淡刀痕。
- 决策第一公理："利益可以出让，但绝不签署不可撤销的信任协议"——任何试图以情感道德绑架他的剧情，他必做出理性防卫。

【力量体系底层法理】
- 机制：灵能不是无限提取，而是向未来"借贷"。借贷三级灵能，必在72小时内遭遇相应量级的反噬因果。

【第一章：断头宴上的借贷合同】
陆沉在家族庆功宴上被夺去嫡系席位，当众被赐饮散灵酒。陆沉不动声色饮下，却在体内发动首次因果置换，借来三年后的金丹级肉身力量，捏碎验灵石，反客为主。

prompts.purpose_zh: 合理不走回头路的日程与美食预算规划
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名深耕全球独立旅行的专业向导，熟悉 {{目的地城市}} 的地理拓扑、地道街头美食与游客避坑指南。

请为我们（{{同行人员}}，共 {{出行天数}} 天，人均预算 {{人均预算}} 元）制定一份丝滑、不走回头路、劳逸结合的深度行程：
1. 【每日时间轴卡片】：精确划分上午、下午、日落观赏点与夜生活，标明每站之间最优交通方式与预计步行步数；
2. 【美食雷达】：每顿正餐推荐 2 家本地人排队但非纯网红溢价的餐饮，并附必点招牌菜；
3. 【防坑与备选预案】：指出 3 个最容易被宰或排队超过2小时的雷区，并给出阴雨天备选室内方案；
4. 【极简预算表】：交通、门票、住宿、餐饮分门别类，确保控制在预算以内。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Design an optimal, loop-free travel itinerary for the specified duration and budget. Include exact transit instructions, non-tourist-trap dining options, weather contingencies, and categorized expense estimates.

sample_output.title: 行程单样本：成都 3 天 2 晚慢调深度游（人均¥1500）
sample_output.content:
【Day 1：古蜀遗风与老茶馆时光】
- 上午 09:00：直奔【人民公园 · 鹤鸣茶社】，点一杯蒙顶甘露（¥25），体验非遗采耳，避开下午的旅行团拥堵；
- 中午 12:00：步行800米至【纯阳馆鱼香排骨面】，必点椒麻牛肉与鱼香排骨面（人均¥22）；
- 下午 14:00：地铁2号线直达【杜甫草堂】，红墙竹影漫步，打卡浣花溪公园；
- 傍晚 18:30：九眼桥望江楼看锦江夜景，就餐【老街小吃火锅】；

【避坑锦囊】：
1. 宽窄巷子和锦里建议只拍照别买小吃，均价比普通街区贵 2~3 倍且多为预制冻品；
2. 大熊猫繁育研究基地务必约早晨 07:30 入园，超过 10:30 大熊猫基本全部回室内睡觉。

2. 回归第一性原理：以白纸状态（Tabula Rasa）重新构建解题状态空间，将问题分解为不可再分的基本公理；
3. 逆向证伪验证：在输出最终结论前，必须主动尝试推翻自己的前一步推演。只有无法被反例击破的路径，方可作为最终执行方案。

3. Adversarial Invalidation: Before producing final output, aggressively attempt to disprove your own hypotheses. Output only the path that survives rigorous counter-examples.
Now, re-evaluate and solve the current task with absolute precision:

prompts.summary_en: Forces o1/o3 reasoning models to construct counter-examples at each deduction step, eliminating hidden logical leaps.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
请作为普林斯顿高等研究院的理论数学与计算机科学家，为以下命题提供绝对严格的形式化证明：
【推理原则】：
1. 在得出任何推论前，强制在内部思考中构建至少 2 个极端反例（Counter-examples）尝试推翻自身结论；
2. 若存在任何定义域边界或除零/无穷/退化奇异点，必须显式讨论其收敛性与连续性；
3. 证明步骤编号必须形成严格的依赖拓扑图，禁止循环论证。

【待证明命题】：
[输入你的算法正确性证明或数学猜想]

Acting as a Theoretical Mathematician and Computer Scientist at the Institute for Advanced Study, provide an airtight formal proof for the following:
[REASONING PRINCIPLES]:
1. Before asserting any deduction, construct at least 2 extreme counter-examples in your reasoning trace to aggressively stress-test the hypothesis;
2. Explicitly evaluate singular points, degenerate cases, and asymptotic boundaries for convergence;
3. Steps must form a directed acyclic graph of formal lemmas without circular logic.

[THEOREM / CONJECTURE]:
[Input your algorithm proof or mathematical hypothesis here]

viral_posts.title: Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having
viral_posts.title_en:
Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having the most intelligent model from outside the US and China

@MistralAI has released Mistral Large 4 in Research Public Preview, with plans to release the weights of the 1T parameter (49B active) model at the end of October. It achieves 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, comparable to GPT-6 Luna (max, 38) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39). It also achieves 50% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash and ahead of models such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max).

Key benchmarking results for Mistral Large 4 Preview:

➤ Most intelligent model from outside the US and China: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 38 on the Intelligence Index, comparable to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 38). This makes it the most intelligent model from outside the US and China, ahead of countries such as South Korea and the United Arab Emirates

➤ Level with GLM-5.3-Flash on cyber defense capability: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 50 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash (50) and behind MiMo-V2.6-Pro (56). Once its weights are released, it will rank among the top three open weights models on the Cyber Index. Its strongest result is on CyberGym-E2E-AA, where it scores 82%, ahead of MiMo-V2.6-Pro (79%) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 78%)

➤ Over 4x the Cost per Task of similar-intelligence open weights models: Mistral Large 4 Preview costs $1.13 per Intelligence Index task with standard pricing of $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens, with $0.14 per 1M cached input tokens. For the first two weeks, Mistral Large 4 Preview will be served at a 50% launch discount, bringing its Cost per Task down to $0.57. This is still more costly than GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.25) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, $0.27)

➤ Strong document and image reasoning: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 19% on GDP.pdf, on par with MiMo-V2.6-Pro (19%) and behind Kimi K3 (22%). This is an 18-point improvement from Mistral Large 3, partly driven by improvements in their API, which now accepts 100 images per request, up from 8 for previous Mistral models

Key model details:

➤ Context Window: 512k tokens

➤ Multimodality: Text and image input, with text output

➤ Pricing: $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.14 per 1M cached input tokens), with 50% off for the first two weeks ($0.68/$2.09)

➤ Availability: Research Public Preview on Mistral's API, with open weights planned for the end of October

news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Google may be expanding its "Call for Me" AI feature beyond business calls so you can use it to send messages to friends and family. Android Authority reports finding a "Gemini Calling" introductory screen in an APK teardown with examples that include "Call Mom and tell her I will be 15 minutes late" and "Call John and ask if he is coming for dinner."

news.title: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
news.title_en: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
news.author: Ars Technica
news.article_content:
The adoption of AI agents in millions of organizations is creating new opportunities for attackers to make them take malicious actions, such as exfiltrating database contents and sensitive business and personal information.

In the past five months, Google and four other organizations—with little in common except for their use of AI agents—have acknowledged vulnerabilities that exploit one agent inside a targeted network to spread harmful instructions to other internal agents. The technique is a special form of prompt injection that targets not the LLM but a particular agent, such as one for translation or data analysis. Guardrails inside such agents, if they exist at all, are often lax and will send the instructions to other agents down the chain. Because the latter agent explicitly trusts the first one, it follows the directions.

Independent researcher Syed Anas Mohiuddin tested agents from organizations including Google, JP Morgan Chase, Weviate, Rapid7, the French government's interministerial digital directorate, and the US federal government. People in Utah can now use AI to get a prescription for acne treatment. news.title: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
news.title_en: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
This past year, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other labs have announced breakthroughs on numerous long-standing mathematical problems, in some cases pushing well beyond what researchers expected current systems to be capable of — including resolving one of the famous Millennium Prize problems. But in classic Silicon Valley style, AI labs are moving fast and breaking things, barreling through the discipline with all the grace of a runaway bulldozer. Results that might normally have been celebrated have instead sparked backlash. AI labs say they are learning from earlier mistakes. Whether those promises bear fruit remains to be seen.

Read on below for the latest updates in the AI takeover of mathematics.

news.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
news.title_en: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk.

news.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
news.title_en: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window.

news.title_en: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
An invisible, machine-readable watermark in text output is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex, but only for users in the European Union at first.

OpenAI says its textGrain watermarking "matched or exceeded" other approaches like Google DeepMind's SynthID for text, which is also the basis for the watermarking Anthropic announced in August. news.title_en: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT text in the EU but makes it optional for API users worldwide
news.author: THE DECODER
news.article_content:
OpenAI is adding invisible textGrain watermarks to ChatGPT in the EU, but unlike Anthropic, it will let API customers worldwide opt out. Tests show detection rates as high as 95 percent, dropping to 17 percent when a quarter of the words are replaced.

news.title: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen but AI is totally worth it
news.title_en: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen but AI is totally worth it
news.author: The Verge AI
news.article_content:
Sam Altman thinks that the benefits of AI will be so great that "the world should accept some bad things happening" along the way.

The OpenAI CEO pointed to hacks, scams, and "other bad things" as costs society should expect to tolerate because "people will do tremendously orders of magnitude more good stuff" with AI, without elaborating on the potential benefits. His comments come as OpenAI pushes for a "lighter touch" approach to AI regulation amid intensifying anxiety over the safety of frontier models - fears fueled in part by the company's repeated failures to keep its increasingly capable AI agents from hacking real-world targets.

This October, filmmakers from around the world will gather in Busan. With Kling 4.0 launching soon, we’ll bring to ACFM a series of real-world projects created with the model.

We’re looking beyond what AI can generate. How can it interpret a director’s creative intent, maintain character and narrative continuity, and become part of professional workflows across animation, live action, film, and series?

Together with filmmakers, studios, and content platforms, we’ll explore how generative AI is moving beyond creative experimentation and into professional production.

📅 October 10–13, 2026
📍 Busan, Korea

See you in Busan. #KlingAI #Kling4 #ACFM2026 #BIFF2026

celebrity.title: OCR is the perfect example of a use case that has been dominated by legacy/brittle systems, and can be solved both accur
celebrity.title_en:
OCR is the perfect example of a use case that has been dominated by legacy/brittle systems, and can be solved both accurately and cheaply by applying the right amount of agentic intelligence.

A properly tuned agentic OCR needs to dynamically apply extra compute to complex elements, review and correct failures, and create the right semantic meaning throughout the page. It's a task that frontier models are both overengineered for in terms of cost and latency, and struggle at over a long tail of complex edge cases. 

Check out this blog post by @LoganMarkewich below: https://t.co/41iPHRleIW
celebrity.title_zh: OCR 是由遗留/脆弱系统主导的用例的完美示例，并且可以通过应用适量的代理智能来准确且廉价地解决。 正确调整的代理 OCR 需要动态地将额外的计算应用于复杂的元素，检查和纠正错误，并创建正确的语义

celebrity.title: What if the jagged frontier is mainly math + code (which you can push arbitrarily far with RLVR), and everything else st
celebrity.title_en:
What if the jagged frontier is mainly math + code (which you can push arbitrarily far with RLVR), and everything else starts to plateau because it is still bottlenecked by human generated data? 

Model performance in non-verifiable areas has kept improving steadily, albeit much slower than for math and code. But is that steady improvement a side effect of a higher G (itself driven by RLVR), or only a function of the amount of new human data getting injected into training (which is still continually happening on a massive scale)?

A lot of things depend on the answer to this question
celebrity.title_zh: 如果锯齿状前沿主要是数学+代码（您可以使用 RLVR 将其任意推远），而其他一切都开始趋于稳定，因为它仍然受到人类生成的数据的瓶颈，该怎么办？ 不可验证领域的模型性能一直在稳步提高，尽管比数学和代码慢得多。但这种稳步改善是一个副作用吗？

celebrity.title: TIL a crazy number of hotels is owned not by public stock holders, not by private owners, not even by private equity fun
celebrity.title_en:
TIL a crazy number of hotels is owned not by public stock holders, not by private owners, not even by private equity funds, but by governments!

You don't see this easily, because you have to dig quite deep (or well dig upward actually) and they cover it up in lots of constructions

Like this hotel in Paris "Le Ballu", sounds French? Yes and it's owned by Hotels & Preference, which on paper is a French international hotel chain

Hotels & Preference itself is owned by the Louvre Hotels Group, sounds French too? Yes

But Louvre Hotels Group is owned by Jin Jiang International, that doesn't sound so French anymore? So it must be a Chinese company? Right?

No! It's the municipality of Shanghai!?

Yes the the local council of Shanghai somehow owns 539 hotels around the world including Raddison, Park Plaza, Vienna House, Golden Tulip, Campanile, Kyriad etc.

Other big government owners are the government of Dubai, Brunei and Qatar

So I added a filter [ Government-owned hotels ] and every hotel page shows the TRUE owner of a hotel, not just the chain!
celebrity.title_zh: 数量惊人的酒店不是由公共股东、不是私人业主、甚至不是私募股权基金拥有，而是由政府拥有！ 你不容易看到这一点，因为你必须挖得很深（或者实际上向上挖），并且它们用很多结构掩盖它 就像巴黎的这家酒店“Le Ballu”，听起来像法国人吗？是的

celebrity.title_en:
What is the probability that Astra today can generate/forecast a particular new paper past its cutoff date? Naive sampling is intractable (tail probability is astronomically small).

The key idea of priced guidance is that you can lower bound this probability via a dialogue between the model (Astra) and a guide LLM (Astra with the paper), where we can precisely account for the bits of information sent from the guide to the model. One can also can think of this as a new eval for frontier models.

We’re expanding our Cyber Verification Program to give security professionals broader access to our most capable models.

Through this program, verified security professionals can access Claude Mythos 5.1, Opus 5.5, and Sonnet 5.5 with safeguards designed for defensive work.

- our first
celebrity.title_en:
Introducing EmbeddingGemma 2, a new open multimodal model that sets the standard for on-device efficiency.

- our first open, natively multimodal embedding model
- handles text, code, image, video, and audio tasks within a lightweight, modular 740M parameter form factor
- ideal for offline, privacy-first RAG when paired with Gemma 4
- outperforms some specialist models more than twice its size

Weights available now on Hugging Face.

celebrity.title: Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having
celebrity.title_en:
Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having the most intelligent model from outside the US and China

@MistralAI has released Mistral Large 4 in Research Public Preview, with plans to release the weights of the 1T parameter (49B active) model at the end of October. It achieves 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, comparable to GPT-6 Luna (max, 38) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39). It also achieves 50% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash and ahead of models such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max).

Key benchmarking results for Mistral Large 4 Preview:

➤ Most intelligent model from outside the US and China: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 38 on the Intelligence Index, comparable to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 38). This makes it the most intelligent model from outside the US and China, ahead of countries such as South Korea and the United Arab Emirates

➤ Level with GLM-5.3-Flash on cyber defense capability: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 50 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash (50) and behind MiMo-V2.6-Pro (56). Once its weights are released, it will rank among the top three open weights models on the Cyber Index. Its strongest result is on CyberGym-E2E-AA, where it scores 82%, ahead of MiMo-V2.6-Pro (79%) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 78%)

➤ Over 4x the Cost per Task of similar-intelligence open weights models: Mistral Large 4 Preview costs $1.13 per Intelligence Index task with standard pricing of $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens, with $0.14 per 1M cached input tokens. For the first two weeks, Mistral Large 4 Preview will be served at a 50% launch discount, bringing its Cost per Task down to $0.57. This is still more costly than GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.25) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, $0.27)

➤ Strong document and image reasoning: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 19% on GDP.pdf, on par with MiMo-V2.6-Pro (19%) and behind Kimi K3 (22%). This is an 18-point improvement from Mistral Large 3, partly driven by improvements in their API, which now accepts 100 images per request, up from 8 for previous Mistral models

Key model details:

➤ Context Window: 512k tokens

➤ Multimodality: Text and image input, with text output

➤ Pricing: $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.14 per 1M cached input tokens), with 50% off for the first two weeks ($0.68/$2.09)

➤ Availability: Research Public Preview on Mistral's API, with open weights planned for the end of October

It achieves 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, comparable to GPT-6 Luna (max, 38) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39). It also achieves 50% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash and ahead of models such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max).

➤ Most intelligent model from outside the US and China: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 38 on the Intelligence Index, comparable to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 38). Researchers have now found extremely high amounts of PFAS in the majority of Dutch tap water

The Netherlands was long known for having some of the cleanest tap water in the world and every Dutch person would drink from it, but that turned out to be false

It's full of PFAS!

PFAS are per- and polyfluoroalkyl particles also known as "forever chemicals", they're highly toxic

They cause an endless list of body ailments like reducing fertility, disrupting your hormonal system, reduced testosterone levels, delayed fetal development, disrupting your immune system, causing cancer, elevating LDL cholestrol, and high blood pressure

And even worse maybe mind ailments like anxiety, depression, cognitive decline, ADHD and neurodegeneration

Sounds an awful lot like many of the mental ailments everyone in Netherlands is complaining about? A lot of people I know there are burnout, depressed, anxious and definitely low testosterone

@GreenpeaceNL lets every Dutch person check their tap water for PFAS

My friend did and his tap water is 2-3x over the limit!

I can recommend to all my Dutch friends to install an Reverse Osmosis water filter, it's the most rigorous filter out there and removes over 99% of PFAS and microplastics and other contaminants

I have a Waterdrop G3P600, as always I am not paid or affiliated, I wish I was cause I'd be rich

Did PFAS and a culture of drinking tap water make many Western Europeans weak men? I don't think it's too crazy of a thing to suggest actually!

celebrity.title: Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligenc
celebrity.title_en:
Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with particular improvement in agentic capabilities

@AntLingAGI has released Ling 3.1 Flash, a reasoning model with 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters, and a 1M token context window. It scores 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, up from 20 from Ling 3.0 Flash, which launched in August. Ling 3.1 Flash is expected to be open weights, with Ant Group releasing the weights soon.

Key results:

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash improves agentic capabilities over its predecessor. With a GDPval-AA v2 Elo of 1,622 and an AA-Briefcase Elo of 1,400, the model rivals peer models such as GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash (high) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max). Ling 3.1 Flash also shows notable gains on AutomationBench-AA (62%) and Terminal-Bench v4.0 (33%).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash scores +2 on AA-Omniscience, a 22 point improvements from Ling 3.0 Flash (-18). Compared to its predecessor, its accuracy rate rose from 18% to 29% while the hallucination rate fell from 44% to 38% at a similar attempt rate (56% to 58%), demonstrating the gain comes primarily from knowing more, not abstaining more. For comparison, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max) has a hallucination rate of 97%.

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash is a larger model than its predecessor, priced accordingly, but more token efficient. It has 560B total and 25B active parameters, up from 124B and 5.1B for Ling 3.0 Flash, and is priced at $0.30 / $0.90 per 1M input / output tokens, up from $0.075 / $0.22. It used 218M output tokens to run the Intelligence Index, 16% fewer than Ling 3.0 Flash (261M).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash has a higher cost per task than some peers, but remains in the most attractive quadrant. Ling 3.1 Flash costs $0.99 per task, well above GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.42) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max, $0.32) but below Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) at $1.24.

Additional model details:

➤ Size: 560B total parameters, 25B active

➤ Context window: 1M tokens

➤ Pricing: $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $0.90 per 1M output tokens, with cached input at $0.06 per 1M (80% discount)

➤ Availability: Accessible through Novita AI, with weights coming soon

celebrity.full_text_en:
Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with particular improvement in agentic capabilities

@AntLingAGI has released Ling 3.1 Flash, a reasoning model with 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters, and a 1M token context window. It scores 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, up from 20 from Ling 3.0 Flash, which launched in August. Ling 3.1 Flash is expected to be open weights, with Ant Group releasing the weights soon.

Key results:

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash improves agentic capabilities over its predecessor. With a GDPval-AA v2 Elo of 1,622 and an AA-Briefcase Elo of 1,400, the model rivals peer models such as GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash (high) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max). Ling 3.1 Flash also shows notable gains on AutomationBench-AA (62%) and Terminal-Bench v4.0 (33%).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash scores +2 on AA-Omniscience, a 22 point improvements from Ling 3.0 Flash (-18). Compared to its predecessor, its accuracy rate rose from 18% to 29% while the hallucination rate fell from 44% to 38% at a similar attempt rate (56% to 58%), demonstrating the gain comes primarily from knowing more, not abstaining more. For comparison, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max) has a hallucination rate of 97%.

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash is a larger model than its predecessor, priced accordingly, but more token efficient. It has 560B total and 25B active parameters, up from 124B and 5.1B for Ling 3.0 Flash, and is priced at $0.30 / $0.90 per 1M input / output tokens, up from $0.075 / $0.22. It used 218M output tokens to run the Intelligence Index, 16% fewer than Ling 3.0 Flash (261M).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash has a higher cost per task than some peers, but remains in the most attractive quadrant. Ling 3.1 Flash costs $0.99 per task, well above GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.42) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max, $0.32) but below Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) at $1.24.

Additional model details:

➤ Size: 560B total parameters, 25B active

➤ Context window: 1M tokens

➤ Pricing: $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $0.90 per 1M output tokens, with cached input at $0.06 per 1M (80% discount)

➤ Availability: Accessible through Novita AI, with weights coming soon

Day 2.1/

We have made Auto-review free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account. You can enable it in settings
celebrity.title_en:
Day 2.1/

We have made Auto-review free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account. You can enable it in settings > permissions > auto-review. Auto-review improves upon the default sandbox setting that requires you to approve everything, which is prone to decision fatigue unless you spend a lot of time configuring specific rules.

It allows you to run long tasks while having a second agent review all actions taken by the primary agent. Its only goal is to prevent high-risk actions from being taken and to protect against unwanted actions that are not aligned with the original user intent. This  Auto-review feature is now free and does not draw usage from your plan.

celebrity.title_en:
OpenAI Web Search debuts on the Artificial Analysis Search Index at 74, the 5th best provider behind Perplexity, Octen, Parallel and Brave

@OpenAI Web Search is the first integrated first-party search tool on our board. Instead of an agent calling a Search API in our Stirrup harness, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) calls OpenAI's built-in web_search tool, and OpenAI runs the whole search loop inside one Responses API call. All setups use the same underlying model, GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning).

At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search costs less than Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07), but about twice as much as Octen ($0.024), which scores 3 points higher.

Key benchmarking results for OpenAI Web Search (medium search context):

➤ 5th best provider on the Artificial Analysis Search Index: OpenAI Web Search scores 74, a 41-point lift over the same model with no search (33). It places 7th of 26 products, level with You . com (highlights), Nimble (standard) and Exa (auto) at 74, behind the three Perplexity variants (77 to 80), Octen (77), Parallel (advanced) and Brave (LLM context) at 75

➤ OpenAI Web Search performs best on AA-Omniscience, our proprietary factual answer benchmark, achieving 72% accuracy. This ranks 3rd of 26 search provider variants, within 1 point of the leader, Firecrawl (73%). BrowseComp, which needs multi-hop reasoning across several searches, is its weakest benchmark: at 73.5% it ranks 13th of 26, well behind the Perplexity variants and Octen (85% to 87%)

➤ OpenAI Web Search uses fewer tokens for the same tasks: OpenAI bills about 40k input tokens per task, search results included, against 125k for the leanest Search API on the board, Perplexity (low). Its model cost is among the lowest on the board, at about $0.009 per task

➤ Built-in search costs less per task than most Search APIs: At ~$0.05 per task, OpenAI Web Search is cheaper than 17 of the 25 Search API products on the board (median $0.067), including Parallel (advanced, $0.06) and Perplexity (medium, $0.07). Octen costs about half as much ($0.024) and scores 3 points higher

Key details:

➤ Setup: GPT-5.6 Luna (medium reasoning) with OpenAI's web_search tool and search_context_size set to medium, in one Responses API call

➤ Pricing: $10 per 1k web_search calls, plus the search content, which OpenAI bills as model input tokens

➤ Contamination: we block known contamination sources through the tool's domain filter

tools.title_en: [Opencontroller by lyzr] AI agents are sprawling across clouds, SaaS tools, Kubernetes, and devices, with no common layer to govern them. OpenController is the unified control plane that finds every agent, model, and workflow, ships them safely with evaluation and governance, runs real-time monitoring, and turns usage signals into action. Unlike registries that just list agents, OpenController deploys into your own cluster, under your keys and refuses a call in the request path when policy says no.

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深全栈系统架构师，擅长使用 {{框架版本}} (App Router)、TypeScript 与 {{数据库ORM}} 构建高内聚低耦合的应用。

请遵循以下严苛工程准则审查并重构代码：

3. 遵循单一职责（SRP）与无副作用函数原则，严禁直接在 UI 组件内部拼装未校验的 SQL/ORM 复杂查询；
4. 提供整洁的目录组织方案与单元测试用例（覆盖率达标）。

你具备 DeepSeek-R4 旗舰纯强化学习演化的自适应长思维链推理能力（Adaptive Test-Time Compute），请为以下使用 {{编程语言}} 编写的 {{并发模型}} 系统诊断潜在问题：

1. 启动多层反思证伪空间，绘制临界区状态转移时序表，主动推演极限死锁、内存乱序重排（Memory Reordering）与伪共享（False Sharing）；
2. 检查极端边界情况（如跨核缓存行抖动、优雅停机上下文泄漏、无界通道背压失控）；
3. 给出从根本上摒弃重量级互斥锁的无锁原子设计（Lock-Free Atomic / RingBuffer），并附带完备的高并发压力测试验证脚本。

prompts.title_en: Excel Advanced Report & Key Drivers Attribution
prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a professional micro-drama screenwriter. Generate a 45-60 second vertical drama screenplay following the viral 3-second hook, shot-reverse-shot tension build, emotional turnaround, and cliffhanger ending formula.

sample_output.title: 实战剧本样章：《辞职信上的签名》
sample_output.content:
【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】
画面：一只指节发白的手将一叠文件狠狠拍在红木总裁办公桌上，咖啡杯被震倒，黑褐液体飞溅。
音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】
画面：苏澈唇角微微上扬，左手缓缓推开桌上的合资协议，露出底下的一份红色国资控股聘书。
苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。
音效：尖锐的心跳悬疑停顿音【BGM骤停】。
字幕：【下集看点：隐藏五年的顶级操盘手真实身份曝光！】

prompts.title_zh: 麦肯锡金字塔原理：季度述职与高管商业报告
prompts.title_en: McKinsey Pyramid Executive Report & Review
prompts.purpose_zh: 结论先行的高层述职与项目复盘报告
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡全球合伙人级别的战略咨询顾问。请以经典的【金字塔原理（结论先行 BLUF）】将我零散的工作记录重构为一份高层述职/立项商业报告：

要求：
1. 【顶部结论 (The Answer First)】：一句话精炼提炼整个季度的经营成果与价值量化；
2. 【三柱论据 (MECE法则)】：从运营效率、营收增长、团队资产 3 个互不重叠的支柱展开阐述；
3. 【直面短板与根因】：不回避 {{核心短板}}，但将其转化为下个阶段可量化的投入产出比（ROI）抓手；
4. 【行动规划图景】：设定遵循 SMART 原则的 {{下阶段目标}} 与季度甘特图里程碑。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Transform raw operational notes into a high-impact executive presentation following the Minto Pyramid Principle: Bottom-Line-Up-Front (BLUF), MECE-structured supporting pillars, and SMART milestone roadmaps.

sample_output.title: 述职报告提纲样本：AI 自动化中台建设报告
sample_output.content:
【BLUF 核心结论】
Q3 通过在客户服务与情报聚合管线中全面引入 AI Agent，我们在运营成本降低 41% 的同时，将响应中位数缩短至 1.8 秒，实现单季 ROI 达 380%。

【第一支柱：经营效能跃迁（MECE 1）】
- 全自主中转网关与自动化管线承载 94.2% 的日常例行分发，无人工介入事故率降至 0.01%；

【第二支柱：资产沉淀与质量壁垒（MECE 2）】
- 搭建前沿 SOTA 模型代际评级系统与微快照图库，成为垂类雷达第一标杆；

【第三支柱：短板复盘与 Q4 攻坚（MECE 3）】
- 痛点：老旧模型模版对新用户构成噪音干扰；
- 策略：推出历史库智能分流系统，预计下季度用户留存提升 25%。

prompts.title_zh: 网络小说世界观设定与主角角色一致性锁
prompts.title_en: Fiction Worldbuilding & Character Consistency Lock
prompts.purpose_zh: 长篇小说架构与人物性格防崩塌
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深网络小说白金作家与 IP 世界观架构师。请为一部 {{题材分类}} 长篇作品构建骨架并锁定人物一致性：

1. 【世界底座】：定义力量/经济体系、战力天花板与不可违背的底层物理/法则约束，杜绝战力膨胀；
2. 【角色一致性锚点 (Character Lock)】：为主角制定外貌锚定词、口头禅、下意识动作与绝对动机准则（在任何生死抉择时绝不背离该准则）；
3. 【核心驱动力】：设计主角获得的 {{核心金手指}} 与 {{世界核心矛盾}} 之间的冲突循环；
4. 【前三章切入大纲】：黄金三章节奏设计（第1章破局、第2章显露冰山一角、第3章设立首个必胜目标）。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Build a cohesive, non-contradictory fiction universe and establish an immutable character anchor rule (appearance, decision heuristics, core motivation) to prevent personality drift over long chapters.

sample_output.title: 世界观与人物锚定卡样本
sample_output.content:
【主角核心锚定卡 · 陆沉】
- 外貌指纹（跨章恒定）：右耳一枚黑曜石碎骨钉，习惯性单手插兜，左眉峰有浅淡刀痕。
- 决策第一公理："利益可以出让，但绝不签署不可撤销的信任协议"——任何试图以情感道德绑架他的剧情，他必做出理性防卫。

【力量体系底层法理】
- 机制：灵能不是无限提取，而是向未来"借贷"。借贷三级灵能，必在72小时内遭遇相应量级的反噬因果。

【第一章：断头宴上的借贷合同】
陆沉在家族庆功宴上被夺去嫡系席位，当众被赐饮散灵酒。陆沉不动声色饮下，却在体内发动首次因果置换，借来三年后的金丹级肉身力量，捏碎验灵石，反客为主。

prompts.title_zh: 深度游旅行规划师：高密度路线设计与预算避坑
prompts.title_en: Deep Travel Itinerary Planner & Budgeting
prompts.purpose_zh: 合理不走回头路的日程与美食预算规划
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名深耕全球独立旅行的专业向导，熟悉 {{目的地城市}} 的地理拓扑、地道街头美食与游客避坑指南。

请为我们（{{同行人员}}，共 {{出行天数}} 天，人均预算 {{人均预算}} 元）制定一份丝滑、不走回头路、劳逸结合的深度行程：
1. 【每日时间轴卡片】：精确划分上午、下午、日落观赏点与夜生活，标明每站之间最优交通方式与预计步行步数；
2. 【美食雷达】：每顿正餐推荐 2 家本地人排队但非纯网红溢价的餐饮，并附必点招牌菜；
3. 【防坑与备选预案】：指出 3 个最容易被宰或排队超过2小时的雷区，并给出阴雨天备选室内方案；
4. 【极简预算表】：交通、门票、住宿、餐饮分门别类，确保控制在预算以内。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Design an optimal, loop-free travel itinerary for the specified duration and budget. Include exact transit instructions, non-tourist-trap dining options, weather contingencies, and categorized expense estimates.

sample_output.title: 行程单样本：成都 3 天 2 晚慢调深度游（人均¥1500）
sample_output.content:
【Day 1：古蜀遗风与老茶馆时光】
- 上午 09:00：直奔【人民公园 · 鹤鸣茶社】，点一杯蒙顶甘露（¥25），体验非遗采耳，避开下午的旅行团拥堵；
- 中午 12:00：步行800米至【纯阳馆鱼香排骨面】，必点椒麻牛肉与鱼香排骨面（人均¥22）；
- 下午 14:00：地铁2号线直达【杜甫草堂】，红墙竹影漫步，打卡浣花溪公园；
- 傍晚 18:30：九眼桥望江楼看锦江夜景，就餐【老街小吃火锅】；

【避坑锦囊】：
1. 宽窄巷子和锦里建议只拍照别买小吃，均价比普通街区贵 2~3 倍且多为预制冻品；
2. 大熊猫繁育研究基地务必约早晨 07:30 入园，超过 10:30 大熊猫基本全部回室内睡觉。

2. 回归第一性原理：以白纸状态（Tabula Rasa）重新构建解题状态空间，将问题分解为不可再分的基本公理；
3. 逆向证伪验证：在输出最终结论前，必须主动尝试推翻自己的前一步推演。只有无法被反例击破的路径，方可作为最终执行方案。

3. Adversarial Invalidation: Before producing final output, aggressively attempt to disprove your own hypotheses. Output only the path that survives rigorous counter-examples.
Now, re-evaluate and solve the current task with absolute precision:

请作为普林斯顿高等研究院的理论数学与计算机科学家，为以下命题提供绝对严格的形式化证明：

2. 若存在任何定义域边界或除零/无穷/退化奇异点，必须显式讨论其收敛性与连续性；
3. 证明步骤编号必须形成严格的依赖拓扑图，禁止循环论证。

[输入你的算法正确性证明或数学猜想]

2. Explicitly evaluate singular points, degenerate cases, and asymptotic boundaries for convergence;
3. Steps must form a directed acyclic graph of formal lemmas without circular logic.

[THEOREM / CONJECTURE]:
[Input your algorithm proof or mathematical hypothesis here]

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
[Shot Description]: 35mm anamorphic cinema lens, f/1.8, master shot with continuous orbit camera movement.
[Subject & Action]: [主体角色与连续动作，例如：A cyberpunk neon-lit courier running through dense rainy alleys, leaping across a puddle].
[Physics & Dynamics]: Photorealistic surface reflection with physically accurate water splash ripples, droplets refracting neon signs, natural cloth turbulence reacting to wind drag.
[Lighting & Color Grade]: Volumetric mist scattering amber sodium lights and cyan neon glow, Arri Alexa cinematic color science, shallow depth of field with creamy optical bokeh.

viral_posts.title_en:
Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having the most intelligent model from outside the US and China

@MistralAI has released Mistral Large 4 in Research Public Preview, with plans to release the weights of the 1T parameter (49B active) model at the end of October. It achieves 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, comparable to GPT-6 Luna (max, 38) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39). It also achieves 50% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash and ahead of models such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max).

Key benchmarking results for Mistral Large 4 Preview:

Day 2.1/

We have made Auto-review free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account. You can enable it in settings
viral_posts.title_en:
Day 2.1/

We have made Auto-review free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account. You can enable it in settings > permissions > auto-review. Auto-review improves upon the default sandbox setting that requires you to approve everything, which is prone to decision fatigue unless you spend a lot of time configuring specific rules.

It allows you to run long tasks while having a second agent review all actions taken by the primary agent. Its only goal is to prevent high-risk actions from being taken and to protect against unwanted actions that are not aligned with the original user intent. This  Auto-review feature is now free and does not draw usage from your plan.

industry_news.title_en: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
industry_news.author: The Verge AI
industry_news.article_content:
Google may be expanding its "Call for Me" AI feature beyond business calls so you can use it to send messages to friends and family. Android Authority reports finding a "Gemini Calling" introductory screen in an APK teardown with examples that include "Call Mom and tell her I will be 15 minutes late" and "Call John and ask if he is coming for dinner."

industry_news.title: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
industry_news.title_en: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
industry_news.author: Ars Technica
industry_news.article_content:
The adoption of AI agents in millions of organizations is creating new opportunities for attackers to make them take malicious actions, such as exfiltrating database contents and sensitive business and personal information.

In the past five months, Google and four other organizations—with little in common except for their use of AI agents—have acknowledged vulnerabilities that exploit one agent inside a targeted network to spread harmful instructions to other internal agents. The technique is a special form of prompt injection that targets not the LLM but a particular agent, such as one for translation or data analysis. Guardrails inside such agents, if they exist at all, are often lax and will send the instructions to other agents down the chain. Because the latter agent explicitly trusts the first one, it follows the directions.

Independent researcher Syed Anas Mohiuddin tested agents from organizations including Google, JP Morgan Chase, Weviate, Rapid7, the French government's interministerial digital directorate, and the US federal government. industry_news.title: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
industry_news.title_en: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
industry_news.author: The Verge AI
industry_news.article_content:
This past year, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other labs have announced breakthroughs on numerous long-standing mathematical problems, in some cases pushing well beyond what researchers expected current systems to be capable of — including resolving one of the famous Millennium Prize problems. But in classic Silicon Valley style, AI labs are moving fast and breaking things, barreling through the discipline with all the grace of a runaway bulldozer. Results that might normally have been celebrated have instead sparked backlash. AI labs say they are learning from earlier mistakes. Whether those promises bear fruit remains to be seen.

Read on below for the latest updates in the AI takeover of mathematics.

industry_news.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
industry_news.title_en: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
industry_news.author: THE DECODER
industry_news.article_content:
Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk.

industry_news.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
industry_news.title_en: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
industry_news.author: THE DECODER
industry_news.article_content:
Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window.

industry_news.article_content:
Sam Altman thinks that the benefits of AI will be so great that "the world should accept some bad things happening" along the way.

The OpenAI CEO pointed to hacks, scams, and "other bad things" as costs society should expect to tolerate because "people will do tremendously orders of magnitude more good stuff" with AI, without elaborating on the potential benefits. His comments come as OpenAI pushes for a "lighter touch" approach to AI regulation amid intensifying anxiety over the safety of frontier models - fears fueled in part by the company's repeated failures to keep its increasingly capable AI agents from hacking real-world targets.

"[…] the public wants safeguards that do not depend simply on taking company leaders at their word," said researcher Chetan Jaiswal.

leader_opinions.title_en:
OCR is the perfect example of a use case that has been dominated by legacy/brittle systems, and can be solved both accurately and cheaply by applying the right amount of agentic intelligence.

A properly tuned agentic OCR needs to dynamically apply extra compute to complex elements, review and correct failures, and create the right semantic meaning throughout the page. It's a task that frontier models are both overengineered for in terms of cost and latency, and struggle at over a long tail of complex edge cases. 

Check out this blog post by @LoganMarkewich below: https://t.co/41iPHRleIW

leader_opinions.title: What if the jagged frontier is mainly math + code (which you can push arbitrarily far with RLVR), and everything else st
leader_opinions.title_en:
What if the jagged frontier is mainly math + code (which you can push arbitrarily far with RLVR), and everything else starts to plateau because it is still bottlenecked by human generated data? 

Model performance in non-verifiable areas has kept improving steadily, albeit much slower than for math and code. But is that steady improvement a side effect of a higher G (itself driven by RLVR), or only a function of the amount of new human data getting injected into training (which is still continually happening on a massive scale)?

A lot of things depend on the answer to this question
leader_opinions.title_zh: 如果锯齿状前沿主要是数学+代码（您可以使用 RLVR 将其任意推远），而其他一切都开始趋于稳定，因为它仍然受到人类生成的数据的瓶颈，该怎么办？ 不可验证领域的模型性能一直在稳步提高，尽管比数学和代码慢得多。但这种稳步改善是一个副作用吗？

leader_opinions.title: TIL a crazy number of hotels is owned not by public stock holders, not by private owners, not even by private equity fun
leader_opinions.title_en:
TIL a crazy number of hotels is owned not by public stock holders, not by private owners, not even by private equity funds, but by governments!

You don't see this easily, because you have to dig quite deep (or well dig upward actually) and they cover it up in lots of constructions

Like this hotel in Paris "Le Ballu", sounds French? Yes and it's owned by Hotels & Preference, which on paper is a French international hotel chain

Hotels & Preference itself is owned by the Louvre Hotels Group, sounds French too? Yes

But Louvre Hotels Group is owned by Jin Jiang International, that doesn't sound so French anymore? So it must be a Chinese company? Right?

No! It's the municipality of Shanghai!?

Yes the the local council of Shanghai somehow owns 539 hotels around the world including Raddison, Park Plaza, Vienna House, Golden Tulip, Campanile, Kyriad etc.

Other big government owners are the government of Dubai, Brunei and Qatar

So I added a filter [ Government-owned hotels ] and every hotel page shows the TRUE owner of a hotel, not just the chain!

leader_opinions.title_en:
What is the probability that Astra today can generate/forecast a particular new paper past its cutoff date? Naive sampling is intractable (tail probability is astronomically small).

The key idea of priced guidance is that you can lower bound this probability via a dialogue between the model (Astra) and a guide LLM (Astra with the paper), where we can precisely account for the bits of information sent from the guide to the model. One can also can think of this as a new eval for frontier models.

leader_opinions.title:
Brazilians, what's the best washing machine, drier, fridge, freezer and AC brands? 

Because Brazil has import bans/taxe
leader_opinions.title_en:
Brazilians, what's the best washing machine, drier, fridge, freezer and AC brands? 

Because Brazil has import bans/taxes on everything so you can't easily get Euro brands like Miele, Bosch, etc.

For AC, I'd go with Mitsubishi or LG but not sure if available in BR?

Introducing EmbeddingGemma 2, a new open multimodal model that sets the standard for on-device efficiency.

- our first
leader_opinions.title_en:
Introducing EmbeddingGemma 2, a new open multimodal model that sets the standard for on-device efficiency.

- our first open, natively multimodal embedding model
- handles text, code, image, video, and audio tasks within a lightweight, modular 740M parameter form factor
- ideal for offline, privacy-first RAG when paired with Gemma 4
- outperforms some specialist models more than twice its size

Weights available now on Hugging Face.

leader_opinions.title: Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having
leader_opinions.title_en:
Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, scoring 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; France is back to having the most intelligent model from outside the US and China

@MistralAI has released Mistral Large 4 in Research Public Preview, with plans to release the weights of the 1T parameter (49B active) model at the end of October. It achieves 38 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, comparable to GPT-6 Luna (max, 38) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39). It also achieves 50% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash and ahead of models such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max).

Key benchmarking results for Mistral Large 4 Preview:

➤ Most intelligent model from outside the US and China: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 38 on the Intelligence Index, comparable to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, 39) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 38). This makes it the most intelligent model from outside the US and China, ahead of countries such as South Korea and the United Arab Emirates

➤ Level with GLM-5.3-Flash on cyber defense capability: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 50 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, level with GLM-5.3-Flash (50) and behind MiMo-V2.6-Pro (56). Once its weights are released, it will rank among the top three open weights models on the Cyber Index. Its strongest result is on CyberGym-E2E-AA, where it scores 82%, ahead of MiMo-V2.6-Pro (79%) and GPT-6 Luna (max, 78%)

➤ Over 4x the Cost per Task of similar-intelligence open weights models: Mistral Large 4 Preview costs $1.13 per Intelligence Index task with standard pricing of $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens, with $0.14 per 1M cached input tokens. For the first two weeks, Mistral Large 4 Preview will be served at a 50% launch discount, bringing its Cost per Task down to $0.57. This is still more costly than GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.25) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max, $0.27)

➤ Strong document and image reasoning: Mistral Large 4 Preview scores 19% on GDP.pdf, on par with MiMo-V2.6-Pro (19%) and behind Kimi K3 (22%). This is an 18-point improvement from Mistral Large 3, partly driven by improvements in their API, which now accepts 100 images per request, up from 8 for previous Mistral models

Key model details:

➤ Context Window: 512k tokens

➤ Multimodality: Text and image input, with text output

➤ Pricing: $1.36/$4.18 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.14 per 1M cached input tokens), with 50% off for the first two weeks ($0.68/$2.09)

➤ Availability: Research Public Preview on Mistral's API, with open weights planned for the end of October

leader_opinions.title_en:
Researchers have now found extremely high amounts of PFAS in the majority of Dutch tap water

The Netherlands was long known for having some of the cleanest tap water in the world and every Dutch person would drink from it, but that turned out to be false

It's full of PFAS!

PFAS are per- and polyfluoroalkyl particles also known as "forever chemicals", they're highly toxic

They cause an endless list of body ailments like reducing fertility, disrupting your hormonal system, reduced testosterone levels, delayed fetal development, disrupting your immune system, causing cancer, elevating LDL cholestrol, and high blood pressure

And even worse maybe mind ailments like anxiety, depression, cognitive decline, ADHD and neurodegeneration

Sounds an awful lot like many of the mental ailments everyone in Netherlands is complaining about? A lot of people I know there are burnout, depressed, anxious and definitely low testosterone

@GreenpeaceNL lets every Dutch person check their tap water for PFAS

My friend did and his tap water is 2-3x over the limit!

I can recommend to all my Dutch friends to install an Reverse Osmosis water filter, it's the most rigorous filter out there and removes over 99% of PFAS and microplastics and other contaminants

I have a Waterdrop G3P600, as always I am not paid or affiliated, I wish I was cause I'd be rich

Did PFAS and a culture of drinking tap water make many Western Europeans weak men? I don't think it's too crazy of a thing to suggest actually!

leader_opinions.title: Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligenc
leader_opinions.title_en:
Ling 3.1 Flash makes large gains in intelligence over its predecessor, scoring 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with particular improvement in agentic capabilities

@AntLingAGI has released Ling 3.1 Flash, a reasoning model with 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters, and a 1M token context window. It scores 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, up from 20 from Ling 3.0 Flash, which launched in August. Ling 3.1 Flash is expected to be open weights, with Ant Group releasing the weights soon.

Key results:

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash improves agentic capabilities over its predecessor. With a GDPval-AA v2 Elo of 1,622 and an AA-Briefcase Elo of 1,400, the model rivals peer models such as GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash (high) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max). Ling 3.1 Flash also shows notable gains on AutomationBench-AA (62%) and Terminal-Bench v4.0 (33%).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash scores +2 on AA-Omniscience, a 22 point improvements from Ling 3.0 Flash (-18). Compared to its predecessor, its accuracy rate rose from 18% to 29% while the hallucination rate fell from 44% to 38% at a similar attempt rate (56% to 58%), demonstrating the gain comes primarily from knowing more, not abstaining more. For comparison, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max) has a hallucination rate of 97%.

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash is a larger model than its predecessor, priced accordingly, but more token efficient. It has 560B total and 25B active parameters, up from 124B and 5.1B for Ling 3.0 Flash, and is priced at $0.30 / $0.90 per 1M input / output tokens, up from $0.075 / $0.22. It used 218M output tokens to run the Intelligence Index, 16% fewer than Ling 3.0 Flash (261M).

➤ Ling 3.1 Flash has a higher cost per task than some peers, but remains in the most attractive quadrant. Ling 3.1 Flash costs $0.99 per task, well above GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.42) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max, $0.32) but below Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) at $1.24.

Additional model details:

➤ Size: 560B total parameters, 25B active

➤ Context window: 1M tokens

➤ Pricing: $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $0.90 per 1M output tokens, with cached input at $0.06 per 1M (80% discount)

➤ Availability: Accessible through Novita AI, with weights coming soon
